exercises.question: Which sentence clearly reports information from a source? [¿Cuál informa claramente de una fuente?]
options: Según la fuente oficial, el suceso ocurrió durante la noche. [According to the official source, the incident happened during the night.]
Me parece extraño. [It seems strange to me.]
No creo que sea posible. [I do not think it is possible.]

exercises.sentence: El periodista dijo que el objeto había __ sobre la ciudad. (aparecer) [The journalist said that the object had appeared over the city.]

exercises.english: I doubt that news is entirely accurate.

sentences: Primero aparecieron los testimonios. [First the testimonies appeared.]
Posteriormente apareció una grabación. [Subsequently a recording appeared.]
Finalmente, los investigadores publicaron un comunicado. [Finally, the investigators published a statement.]

exercises.question: Which expression normally takes the subjunctive? [¿Qué expresión normalmente lleva subjuntivo?]
options: Es posible que [It is possible that]
Es evidente que [It is clear that]
Creo que [I think that]

exercises.sentence: Es evidente que la noticia __ una reacción inmediata. (provocar) [It is clear that the news has caused an immediate reaction.]

exercises.english: In summary, the news report is about a phenomenon without a definitive explanation.

exercises.question: Which verb introduces another person's words? [¿Qué verbo introduce las palabras de otra persona?]
options: afirmar [to state]
suceder [to happen]
destacar [to highlight]

exercises.sentence: La testigo afirmó que había visto una luz desde su ventana.
options: The witness stated that she had seen a light from her window.
The witness said she would see a light tomorrow.
The witness denied seeing any light.

exercises.sentence: Posteriormente apareció una grabación breve en las redes sociales.
options: Subsequently a brief recording appeared on social media.
First the recording disappeared before anyone reported it.
The recording was published tomorrow.

exercises.sentence: Lo más importante es que todavía faltan pruebas independientes.

options: Dijo que los datos principales estaban confirmados. [It said that the main data were confirmed.]
Dijo que los datos se confirmarán ayer. [It said that the data will be confirmed yesterday.]
Dijo que los datos confirmaban mañana. [It said that the data were confirming tomorrow.]
Es una opinión, porque no creo que la fuente sea completamente fiable. [It is an opinion because I do not think the source is completely reliable.]
Es un hecho, porque es posible que la fuente sea fiable. [It is a fact because it is possible that the source is reliable.]
Es una opinión, porque es evidente que los datos coinciden. [It is an opinion because it is clear that the data coincide.]

Primero llegaron los testimonios, posteriormente apareció un vídeo y finalmente los investigadores publicaron un comunicado. [First the testimonies arrived, subsequently a video appeared, and finally the investigators published a statement.]
Finalmente llegaron los testimonios ayer y posteriormente llegarán mañana. [Finally the testimonies arrived yesterday and subsequently they will arrive tomorrow.]
Primero publicaron el comunicado mañana y después investigaban ayer. [First they published the statement tomorrow and then they were investigating yesterday.]

exercises.question: Which sentence combines summary with evaluation? [¿Cuál combina resumen y evaluación?]
options: En resumen, hay testimonios, pero no creo que la información sea completamente fiable. [In summary, there are testimonies, but I do not think the information is completely reliable.]
Hay testimonios. [There are testimonies.]
La fuente informó de un vídeo. [The source reported a video.]

template.prompt: Report information, sequence two developments and give a cautious evaluation.
template.answer: Según los testigos, apareció una luz; posteriormente surgió un vídeo. No creo que la información sea completamente fiable todavía.

template.prompt: Write a short summary of a news story and respond to it.
template.answer: En resumen, varias personas informaron de un fenómeno extraño y posteriormente aparecieron nuevas pruebas. Mi reacción es de cautela porque todavía faltan datos independientes.
